The objectives of this notebook will be to conduct statistical analyses of the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet Clean version 2 assuming baseline BLM assumptions (HA 10% Closed System).

```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt/Copper/5. Cluster analysis")
```

# Identifying Stream Typologies

Since this was already done in the Stat analysis Rmd in the Zinc folder, we just need to merge the column Typology from the dataset in that folder with this one

```{r}
library(readxl)

dat <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt/Copper/4. Exploratory data analysis/Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean2.xlsx", 
    sheet = "HA 10% Closed System")

head(dat)
```

Upload the Zinc Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean3.xlsx and ensure Typology and Typology2 exists

```{r}
zn_dat <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt/Zinc/5. Cluster analysis/Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean3.xlsx", 
    sheet = "HA 10% Closed System")

str(zn_dat$Typology)
str(zn_dat$Typology2)
```

Merge the Typology and Typology2 columns to dat by Sample_ID

```{r}
library(dplyr)

dat <- dat %>%
  left_join(
    zn_dat %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Typology),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    zn_dat %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Typology2),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  )

# Check
str(dat$Typology)
str(dat$Typology2)
```

Save to Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean3.xlsx to this working directory

```{r}
library(openxlsx)

# 1. Create a brand-new workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# 2. Add your sheet
addWorksheet(wb, "HA 10% Closed System")

# 3. Write your updated dat to the sheet
writeData(wb, sheet = "HA 10% Closed System", dat)

# 4. Save — overwrite the entire file
saveWorkbook(wb, "Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean3.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```
